claims.statement: For every finite ordinary tree T with alpha(T), first strict descent x(T), and natural p satisfying x(T)+2<=p, 3p<2alpha(T)+1, and |V(T)|=2p+2, the complete sum over original leaves v with Delta_p(T-v)<0 of Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s_v})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s_v]) is nonpositive.
claims.scope: Registered universal first-order-shell assertion. The audited evidence narrows to all 19,320 unlabeled ordinary trees of order 16 at p=7: 1,696 satisfy both guards (each has alpha=11 and x=5), and all have S<0, with range -1759 through -906.

limitations: The verified census is bounded to p=7 and |V(T)|=16 and cannot establish the universal shell assertion.
